reasons: Datadog asks for sum of nginx.connections.active filtered by the host template variable; the candidate computes avg(state=active) minus sum(state=waiting), which is a different quantity.
The subtraction introduces a waiting-connections term that is not in the request, and the avg aggregation does not match the Datadog sum.

The candidate drops the $host template matcher (host prefix, default *), so grouping and scope differ. The dataset does not list a host label, so the correct label name needs checking before it is added.
A translation with state="active" and sum aggregation over nginx.connections_current (non-monotonic sum, unit {connections}) would match the request, so translated is the right outcome.
